title: OpenCues AUDITOR.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of an AUDITOR.md file. Spec: opencues/0.1-alpha. See /spec/auditor-spec.md.

name.description: Unique identifier for this auditor. Lowercase, hyphens permitted. Should match the folder basename.

description.description: Human-readable summary. NOT read by the LLM. Validators warn when absent.

priority.description: Concat ordering — higher number appears earlier in the composed prompt. Ties broken by alphabetical folder name.

enabled.description: When false, the auditor is parsed but skipped during composition.

on-host.description: Allow-list of host names that may load this auditor.
